name: SVFAP (Self-supervised Video Facial Affect Perceiver)
authors_or_creators: Licai Sun, Zheng Lian, Bin Liu, Jianhua Tao (Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Tsinghua University)
backbone: ViT (Video Transformer with temporal-aware spatial-temporal encoder)
accuracy_affectnet: not reported (model focuses on dynamic/video benchmarks) [uncertain]
pretrained_weights_available: yes - released on the official GitHub repository
hardware_requirements: Pretraining performed on multiple NVIDIA A100/V100 GPUs; finetuning feasible on a single high-memory GPU [uncertain]
loss_function: Self-supervised reconstruction loss (MSE on masked spatio-temporal tubes) for pretraining; cross-entropy for downstream emotion classification finetuning
training_data_used: Pretraining: VoxCeleb2 (face videos, label-free). Finetuning: DFEW, FERV39k, MAFW, Aff-Wild2, CREMA-D, RAVDESS, and additional dynamic FER datasets
pretraining_strategy: self-supervised (temporal-aware masked autoencoding with high masking ratio on spatio-temporal tubes)
dynamic_fer_metrics: DFEW: UAR ~62.83 / WAR ~74.27; FERV39k: UAR ~42.14 / WAR ~52.29; MAFW: UAR ~41.19 / WAR ~54.28; Aff-Wild2 expression F1 reported [uncertain]
abaw_metrics: Reported on Aff-Wild2 expression track; expression F1 reported in paper [uncertain]
cross_dataset_generalization: Demonstrates strong transfer across DFEW/FERV39k/MAFW after single pretraining; explicit cross-dataset matrix reported in paper [uncertain]
robustness: not specifically evaluated on Occlusion-RAF-DB / Pose-RAF-DB benchmarks [uncertain]
explainability: Attention map visualizations of spatio-temporal regions discussed in paper
